title: AnimClipEntry
description: One clip in the Grudge Open animation database (bake path + roles + state tags).

pack.description: Anim pack id (sword_shield, longbow, polearm, unarmed, twohand, crossbow, rifle, magic, traversal, harvest, swim, climb)

role.description: Logical mixer role: idle, walk, run, attack, skill1, swim, climbUp, mantle, harvest, …

bakeRel.description: Path under /anims/baked/ without .json (Bip001 JSON SSOT for grudge6)

sourceRel.description: Author FBX/GLB path under public/ or raw/ when bake missing

states.description: AnimState ids this clip may drive

priority.description: Higher wins when multiple clips match

lockSec.description: Action lock timing (from Explosive WarriorTiming or authoring)
